raw_segments.text: I noticed these objects cursorily only. In them there was nothing extraordinary. A group
of more interest appeared near the hearth, sitting still amidst the rosy peace and warmth
suffusing it. Two young, graceful women, ladies in every
point, sat, one in a low rocking chair, the other on a lower stool. Both wore deep mourning
of crepe and bombazine, which somber garbs singularly set off very fair necks and faces.
A large old pointer dog rested its massive head on the knee of one girl. In the lap of
the other was cushioned a black cat.
